questions.question: What structure is circled?
questions.explanation: Ductus arteriosus - connects the pulmonary artery to the aorta.

questions.question: What structure is circled?
questions.explanation: Foramen ovale - connects the right and left atria.

questions.question: What structure is circled?
questions.explanation: Ductus venosus - connects the umbilical vein to the inferior vena cava.
